def solve(I):
    R,C=len(I),len(I[0])
    cs=comps_of(I)
    k=min(cs,key=lambda cp:min(p[1] for p in cp))   # leftmost component keeps position
    topk=min(p[0] for p in k)
    # centers aligned to key's center (works for both demos)
    cc=(min(p[0] for p in k)+max(p[0] for p in k))/2
    out=[[0]*C for _ in range(R)]
    for cp in cs:
        rs=[p[0] for p in cp]
        cur_c=(min(rs)+max(rs))/2
        d=int(round(cc-cur_c))
        for r,c in cp:
            rr=r+d
            if 0<=rr<R: out[rr][c]=I[r][c]
    return out
for k in [1,2]:
    print(k, solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output'])

def f(I):
    cs=comps_of(I)
    lc=min(cs,key=lambda c:min(p[1] for p in c))   # leftmost component: anchor, stays
    others=[c for c in cs if c is not lc]
    t=min(min(p[0] for p in c) for c in others)     # target top = min top of non-leftmost
    out=[[0]*len(I[0]) for _ in I]
    out_lc=[r for r,_ in lc]
    out.append=None
    # rebuild: shift every component to top=t
    for c in cs:
        top=min(p[0] for p in c)
        dr=t-top
        for r,cx in c:
            out[r+dr][cx]=I[r][cx]
    return out

def f(I):
    cs=[c for c in shapes(I) if True]
    sc=sorted(cs,key=lambda c:min(p[0] for p in c))
    n=len(sc)
    o=[row[:] for row in I]
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    # stack shapes contiguously starting at the smallest top
    start=min(min(p[0] for p in c) for c in cs)
    prev_r=start-1
    for s in sc:
        r0=min(p[0] for p in s); r1=max(p[0] for p in s)
        gap=r0-(prev_r+1)
        if gap>0:
            for r,x in s: o[r][x]=I[r][x]  # clear old location
        newr0=newr0=(r0-gap) if gap!=0 else None
        for dy,dx in ((0,x) for x in range(W)):
            pass
        for r,x in s:
            nr=r+start-r0
            o[nr][x]=I[r][x]
        prev_r=r0-gap+r1
    return o
